meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调度一批互相依赖的子任务,按阶段依次执行,失败自动重试补救
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要让一大批有先后依赖的任务分成多个子任务按序跑完
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must fan out many interdependent tasks across child workers in order

howto.what: 当任务之间存在先后依赖(比如写文档要先审计再改写)时,Claude 会把它们定义成一个 DAG,按依赖分批并行跑子任务;单个节点出错时只重跑那一个节点,已完成节点的结果会复用。
howto.when: 当你提到 “mass-ulw”、“任务 DAG” 等关键词,或要求做存在真实依赖的分批并行任务时触发。完全独立的并行任务用普通 task 即可。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把「先审计文档、再改写、最后校验」建成 DAG 跑一遍
say.note: 会构建并启动一个 run

say.text: retry 一下 lint 节点,并把它改成只检查 src 目录
say.note: 只重跑该节点及其下游

say.text: amend 这个 run,新增一个节点,只重跑改动的部分
say.note: 未改动节点的缓存结果保留

howto.what_en: When tasks depend on earlier ones, Claude defines a DAG of nodes, runs them in parallel waves as dependencies clear, one run per phase, and recovers a single bad node via retry, send, or amend while reusing finished nodes' cached results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others. For fully independent workers, plain parallel task spawns are simpler.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to run audit → rewrite → verify as a DAG
Retry the lint node and change it to only check src/
say_en.note: Re-runs that node and its dependents

say_en.text: Amend this run: add a node and re-run only what changed
